note: the canonical verdict signature each fixture must reproduce: verdict, sorted refusal codes, sorted finding codes. q01 to q03 add the own JSON key "__proto__" to one signed record after signing; q04 to q06 add an ordinary unknown key the same way and must give the same signature

q00_base.intent: the clean grant, receipt and intent every other vector changes by one added field: accepted

q01_own_proto_in_grant.intent: the own JSON key "__proto__" added to the signed grant after signing. Section 2 keeps every non-derived field in the preimage, so grant_ref no longer recomputes (execution_invalid, grant_recompute_mismatch) and caller_sig no longer verifies over the full preimage (execution_signature_invalid); the intent names the grant by the stored grant_ref, which is no longer this grant's recomputed id (preflight_invalid, intent_unbound). A verifier whose copy of the record drops an own "__proto__" key (Object.assign) accepts

q02_own_proto_in_receipt.intent: the same key added to the signed receipt: receipt_id does not recompute (execution_invalid), provider_sig does not verify (execution_signature_invalid), and no authentic receipt is left to reconcile (execution_unreconciled)

q03_own_proto_in_intent.intent: the same key added to the signed intent: intent_id does not recompute (preflight_invalid, intent_recompute_mismatch) and intent_sig does not verify (preflight_signature_invalid); the grant and receipt are untouched, so the execution step passes

q04_audit_note_in_grant.intent: control: an ordinary unknown key "audit_note" added to the grant after signing. Same signature as q01; a verifier must not tell the two apart

q05_audit_note_in_receipt.intent: control: the same ordinary key added to the receipt. Same signature as q02

q06_audit_note_in_intent.intent: control: the same ordinary key added to the intent. Same signature as q03
